semanticDecisions.decision: Replaced repeated call-center incentive/feedback vignette with authored demand/order amplification evidence; the assessed systems principle remains appropriate.
Replaced generic concurrent-change training design with explicit team randomization and cluster-level uncertainty; distinct from mere staged rollout.
Retained split-plot topic but changed task from generic model identification to two error-stratum degrees of freedom under a complete balanced allocation.
Replaced misaligned generalized count-model question with authored continuous-response ANCOVA interaction interpretation, preserving the assigned current-BoK general-linear-model topic.

limitations: Lexical similarity is a screen, not proof of semantic uniqueness or psychometric local independence.
Shared governance, mandatory-constraint, capability and DOE themes remain intentionally represented; context changes alone do not establish independent latent constructs.
No response data were supplied; difficulty, discrimination, distractor functioning, DIF, and exam reliability remain uncalibrated.
Question-order randomization exists in the production player. Browser audit fixtures intentionally impose canonical order; no learner-history IDs or stored answer indices were renumbered.
